---
title: "Simulations"
---

The simulation page has been split. The benchmarks are now:

- [Simulation 4: One function across remote homologs](simulation_kofam.html):
  one COG enriched from MMseqs2 30% clusters that no other sample uses;
  bins against proteins, MMseqs2 30% clusters and the COG label.
- [Simulation 3: MMD, optimal transport and UniFrac](simulation_distances.html):
  MMD, optimal transport on the embeddings and on the MCL graph, and
  weighted UniFrac on an MCL tree, on one FunFam contrast.
- [MCL parameters](parameters.html): how the graph thresholds and inflation
  shape the bins.

The earlier Simulation 1 (CATH FunFam domains) and Simulation 2 (EC3 enzyme
classes) pages are no longer linked from the navigation: FunFam's unit is a
domain, not Korect's full-length protein, and a four-level EC number can
group structurally unrelated, convergent enzymes. Their files and curated
data are still on the `gh-pages` branch for reference.
